note: The allowed twin: step 1's register with the second entry on its own column OTHER. Each column is one record and one case, so both variables build, each with the variant's 2010-2018 window (the period intersection of thin-delivery-period-intersects-register-variant-and-variable-bounds).
fails_if: `_compile_thin_register` refuses two thin variables of one register on different columns, so this build stops with step 1's refusal

sources.description: Authored FK register r (2000-2020), variant v (2010-2018), variable Col on column COL and variable Other on column OTHER. Plus the SCB sample.

files.Forsakringskassan/fk.toml:
[[register]]
key = "r"
name = "R"
valid_from = "2000-01-01"
valid_to = "2020-12-31"
[[register.variant]]
key = "v"
name = "V"
valid_from = "2010-01-01"
valid_to = "2018-12-31"
[[register.variable]]
name = "Col"
column = "COL"
data_type = "int"
variants = ["v"]
valid_from = "2005-01-01"
valid_to = "2019-12-31"
[[register.variable]]
name = "Other"
column = "OTHER"
data_type = "int"
variants = ["v"]
valid_from = "2005-01-01"
valid_to = "2019-12-31"
